scenes.title: Airflow carries dirt into the vacuum
The fan creates a pressure difference
Moving air transports and separates dirt
Fan, airflow, and collection form one chain

vo.text: This vacuum cleaner lifts dirt from the floor and carries it into a collection bin.
vo.speak: This vacuum cleaner lifts dirt from the floor and carries it into a collection bin.

vo.text: It does this by creating a continuous airflow, not by pulling on each particle directly.
vo.speak: It does this by creating a continuous airflow, not by pulling on each particle directly.

vo.text: An electric motor spins a fan that pushes air out of the cleaner.
vo.speak: An electric motor spins a fan that pushes air out of the cleaner.

vo.text: That lowers the air pressure inside, so room air rushes in through the nozzle.
vo.speak: That lowers the air pressure inside, so room air rushes in through the nozzle.

vo.text: The moving air carries loose dust and debris along the suction path.
vo.speak: The moving air carries loose dust and debris along the suction path.

vo.text: A cyclone or filter separates the dirt from that air before the air leaves the machine.
vo.speak: A cyclone or filter separates the dirt from that air before the air leaves the machine.

vo.text: A clogged filter restricts airflow, which is why cleaning it can restore cleaning performance.
vo.speak: A clogged filter restricts airflow, which is why cleaning it can restore cleaning performance.

vo.text: So the fan starts an airflow, and the moving air transports dirt into the vacuum.
vo.speak: So the fan starts an airflow, and the moving air transports dirt into the vacuum.
